articles.title: Trump Media moves another $205 million in bitcoin as losses on crypto bet swell to $455 million
articles.snippet: DJT’s bitcoin strategy remains under pressure as the company sits on hundreds of millions in unrealized crypto losses and widening quarterly deficits.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks, Policy Experts Press Congress to Modernize Bank Secrecy Act
articles.snippet: A House subcommittee hearing exposed a divide over how far to scale back the 1970-era anti-money laundering law as Trump expands its reach.

articles.title: Trump Media Moves Over $200 Million in Bitcoin as Losses Pile Up: Arkham
articles.snippet: It's unknown whether Trump Media & Technology Group is selling its Bitcoin, though it has amassed sizable losses on its holdings.

articles.title: Trump Halts AI Order Over Fears It Could Hurt US Edge Over China
articles.snippet: Trump said he delayed the order because parts of the proposal risked slowing the U.S. AI industry as competition with China intensifies.

articles.title: Crypto Backing or Trump Pump? Fairshake PAC Claims Primary Victories
articles.snippet: Fairshake said six primary victories on Tuesday revealed a “powerful bipartisan mandate” for pro-crypto policies. But other factors appear to have been at play.
